properties.description: Minimum selectable date. `ISODateString` is a template literal type (`\`${number}${number}${number}${number}-${number}${number}-${number}${number}\``). properties.name: minRangeSpan
properties.description: Minimum days a selected range must span, counting both endpoints (`2` forbids a single-day range). Once a start is picked, days closer than this are disabled. Clicking the start again commits a one-day range when allowed, or cancels the in-progress selection when the minimum is longer. Defaults to 1 (same-day start and end allowed).

properties.name: maxRangeSpan
properties.description: Maximum days a selected range may span, counting both endpoints (`7` = a 7-day window, start + 6). Once a start is picked, days beyond this distance are disabled so the range cannot stretch past the cap. Rolling window relative to the start; for fixed calendar bounds use `min`/`max`. Constrains selection only; it never rewrites a `value` already wider than the cap (flag that with `status`).

properties.description: Whether to show a search input for filtering options. As the user types, the match count (or "No results found") is announced to screen readers via a polite live region. The search field has built-in affordances: a leading magnifier icon and, once a query is typed, a trailing clear (✕) button that resets the query and returns focus to the input. Default: false.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Placeholder text shown when no value is selected. Default: 'Select...'.

properties.name: size
properties.description: Size variant for the selector. Default: 'md'.

properties.name: isReadOnly
properties.description: Makes the selector read-only: the selected value stays visible, focusable, and included in form submission, and retains its combobox identity with aria-readonly. The selection surface, clear action, and disclosure indicator are removed. Unlike isDisabled, the control is not dimmed. isDisabled takes precedence when both are set. Default: false.

properties.name: htmlName
properties.description: The HTML name attribute for form submissions. Renders a hidden input carrying the selected value, like a native select.

properties.name: hasClear
properties.description: Shows a clear (×) button when a value is selected. When true, onChange also accepts null to signal the user cleared the selection. Default: false.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Currently selected value.

properties.name: onChange
properties.description: Callback fired when the selection changes.

name: Slider

properties.name: label
properties.description: Label text (always rendered for accessibility).

properties.name: description
properties.description: Description text rendered below the label.

properties.name: isLabelHidden
properties.description: Whether to visually hide the label. Default: false.

properties.name: isRequired
properties.description: Whether the field is required. Default: false.

properties.name: isDisabled
properties.description: Whether the slider is disabled. Default: false.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Status indicator object (`{ type, message }`) for validation feedback.

properties.name: width
properties.description: Width of the field (number = pixels, string used as-is, e.g. "100%"). Sizes the whole field (label, control, and status) so they stay aligned.

properties.name: min
properties.description: Minimum value. Default: 0.

properties.name: max
properties.description: Maximum value. Default: 100.

properties.name: step
properties.description: Step increment. Default: 1.

properties.name: htmlName
properties.description: The HTML name attribute for form submissions. Renders hidden inputs carrying the current value (two entries in range mode).

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current value: a `number` for single thumb mode or `[number, number]` for range mode.

properties.name: onChange
properties.description: Callback fired on value change during drag.

properties.name: onChangeEnd
properties.description: Callback fired when drag ends.

properties.name: minStepsBetweenThumbs
properties.description: Minimum number of steps between thumbs in range mode; prevents thumbs from overlapping. Default: 0.

name: Stack

properties.name: children
properties.description: Stack content.

properties.name: gap
properties.description: Spacing step (number literal): 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10. Pass as a JSX number expression e.g. gap={4}, NOT a string like gap="4". Default: 3.

properties.name: padding
properties.description: Inner padding on all sides, using the spacing scale. Pass as a JSX number expression e.g. padding={3}. Default: 0.

properties.name: direction
properties.description: Direction of the stack layout. 'horizontal' flows items left-to-right (like HStack), 'vertical' flows top-to-bottom (like VStack). Note: the value is 'horizontal', NOT 'row'. Default: 'vertical'.

properties.name: justify
properties.description: Main-axis alignment alias. Resolves to hAlign (horizontal) or vAlign (vertical). Note: use 'between', NOT 'space-between'. Default: 'start'.

properties.name: align
properties.description: Cross-axis alignment alias. Mirrors CSS align-items. Default: 'stretch'.

properties.name: wrap
properties.description: Flex wrap behavior. Default: 'nowrap'.

properties.name: StackItem.size
properties.description: The StackItem.size prop. Default: 'static'.

properties.name: StackItem.isScrollable
properties.description: The StackItem.isScrollable prop. Default: false.

name: StatusDot

properties.name: label
properties.description: Accessible label surfaced via aria-label.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Semantic color variant.

properties.name: tooltip
properties.description: Tooltip text shown on hover to explain the status meaning.

name: Stepper

properties.name: children
properties.description: Step elements to render in the stepper.

properties.name: activeStep
properties.description: Zero-based index of the currently active step. Steps before this index are marked as completed. Default: 0.

properties.name: orientation
properties.description: Layout direction of the stepper. Default: 'horizontal'.

name: Switch

properties.name: label
properties.description: Label text for the switch (always rendered for accessibility).

properties.name: description
properties.description: Description text displayed below the label.

properties.name: isLabelHidden
properties.description: Visually hides the label while keeping it accessible to screen readers. Default: false.

properties.name: isRequired
properties.description: Whether the switch is required. Mutually exclusive with isOptional. Default: false.

properties.name: isDisabled
properties.description: Whether the switch is disabled. Default: false.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Status indicator with type and message. Displays a colored message box below the switch and sets aria-invalid when type is "error".

properties.name: width
properties.description: Width of the field (number = pixels, string used as-is, e.g. "100%"). Sizes the whole field (label, control, and status) so they stay aligned.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Whether the switch is on or off.

properties.name: onChange
properties.description: Callback fired when the switch state changes.

properties.name: htmlName
properties.description: The HTML name attribute for the underlying checkbox input, useful for form submissions (submits "on" when the switch is on).

properties.name: size
properties.description: Size variant controlling track and thumb dimensions. sm (32x20px) matches sm checkbox/radio vertical rhythm; md (40x24px, default) matches md checkbox/radio vertical rhythm. Default: 'md'.

name: Table

properties.name: data
properties.description: Array of data items to render as rows. T must extend Record<string, unknown> (use `interface MyRow extends Record<string, unknown>` for custom types).

properties.name: idKey
properties.description: Row key for React reconciliation. Pass a property name string or a function. Falls back to row index if omitted.

properties.name: density
properties.description: Row density controlling cell padding and font size. Default: 'balanced'.

properties.name: hasHover
properties.description: Applies a hover highlight background to rows on pointer devices. Default: false.

properties.name: isStriped
properties.description: Applies a background wash to even-numbered rows. Default: false.

properties.name: columns
properties.type: { key: string; header?: ViewNode; width?: ColumnWidth; align?: "start" | "center" | "end"; renderCell?: ((row: T) => ViewNode); }[]
properties.description: Column definitions: each column has {key, header, width?, align?, renderCell?}. The `header` field sets the column heading text. If omitted, columns are auto-generated from data object keys. The `width` field is typed as `ColumnWidth` (not a number); use `proportional(n)` or `pixel(n)` helpers imported from `@astryxdesign/core/Table`. Example: `width: pixel(120)` for 120px fixed, `width: proportional(1)` for flex distribution.

name: Tabs

properties.name: gap
properties.description: The gap prop. Default: 3.

properties.name: hasDivider
properties.description: The hasDivider prop. Default: false.

name: Text

properties.name: children
properties.description: Text content.

properties.name: color
properties.description: Text color. Defaults to 'secondary' for the 'supporting' type, 'primary' for all others. Themes may add custom colors. Default: (props.type === 'supporting' ? 'secondary' : 'primary').

properties.name: type
properties.description: Semantic text type. Determines size, weight, and line-height from the theme. 'inherit' takes all three from the surrounding text instead. Themes may add custom types. Note: this prop is called `type`, not `variant`. Default: 'body'.

name: TextArea

properties.name: label
properties.description: Label text for the textarea. Always rendered for accessibility.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Helper text displayed between the label and textarea.

properties.name: isLabelHidden
properties.description: Visually hides the label while keeping it accessible to screen readers. Default: false.

properties.name: isRequired
properties.description: Displays a "Required" indicator next to the label and sets aria-required. Mutually exclusive with isOptional. Default: false.

properties.name: isDisabled
properties.description: Disables the textarea, preventing interaction. Default: false.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Status indicator that applies a colored border and icon. An optional message is displayed in a floating box below the textarea.

properties.name: width
properties.description: Width of the field (number = pixels, string used as-is, e.g. "100%"). Sizes the whole field (label, control, and status) so they stay aligned.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current value of the textarea.

properties.name: onChange
properties.description: Callback fired when the textarea value changes.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Placeholder text shown when the textarea is empty.

properties.name: rows
properties.description: Number of visible text rows. Default: 3.

properties.name: maxLength
properties.description: Maximum number of characters allowed, counted as user-perceived characters: an emoji or flag sequence counts as one. When set, a character counter (current/max) is displayed inside the input container, anchored to the bottom-right beneath the text. Does not enforce the limit natively; when exceeded the counter turns red and shows a warning icon (a non-color cue), and screen-reader users hear the remaining/over-limit count announced. Consumers validating the limit should count with characterCount (exported from the package) so enforcement matches the displayed count.

properties.name: isReadOnly
properties.description: Makes the textarea read-only: the value is shown at full opacity and still submits with the form, but cannot be edited. Unlike isDisabled, a read-only textarea is not dimmed and stays in the tab order. isDisabled takes precedence when both are set. Default: false.

properties.name: hasSpellCheck
properties.description: Enables or disables browser spell checking. Default: true.

properties.name: hasAutoFocus
properties.description: Automatically focuses the textarea on mount. Default: false.

properties.name: htmlName
properties.description: HTML name attribute for the textarea element, useful for form submissions.

properties.name: autoComplete
properties.description: The native autocomplete attribute, forwarded to the textarea unchanged. Does not affect the controlled value.

name: TextInput

properties.name: label
properties.description: Label text for the input: always rendered for accessibility.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Description text displayed between the label and input.

properties.name: isLabelHidden
properties.description: Visually hides the label while keeping it accessible to screen readers. Default: false.

properties.name: isRequired
properties.description: Displays a "Required" indicator next to the label and sets aria-required. Mutually exclusive with isOptional. Default: false.

properties.name: isDisabled
properties.description: Disables the input, preventing interaction and dimming the element. Default: false.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Validation status: applies a colored border and status icon. If message is provided, displays a floating message below the input. Error type also sets aria-invalid.

properties.name: width
properties.description: Width of the field (number = pixels, string used as-is, e.g. "100%"). Sizes the whole field (label, control, and status) so they stay aligned.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current value of the input.

properties.name: onChange
properties.description: Callback fired when the input value changes.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Placeholder text shown when the input is empty.

properties.name: type
properties.description: The HTML input type. Default: 'text'.

properties.name: size
properties.description: Size variant of the input. Default: 'md'.

properties.name: htmlName
properties.description: The HTML name attribute for the input, useful for form submissions.

properties.name: autoComplete
properties.description: The native autocomplete attribute, forwarded to the input unchanged. Does not affect the controlled value.

properties.name: isReadOnly
properties.description: Makes the input read-only: the value is shown at full opacity and still submits with the form, but cannot be edited. Unlike isDisabled, a read-only input is not dimmed and stays in the tab order. isDisabled takes precedence when both are set. Default: false.

properties.name: hasClear
properties.description: Shows a clear (×) button when the input has a value. Clicking it clears the value and returns focus to the input. Default: false.

properties.name: hasAutoFocus
properties.description: Automatically focuses the input on mount. Default: false.

properties.name: startIcon
properties.description: SVG icon component displayed at the start of the input. See `astryx docs icons` for valid semantic names.

properties.name: onEnter
properties.description: Callback fired when the user presses the Enter key. IME-safe: Enter used to commit a Japanese/Chinese/Korean conversion does not fire it.

name: TimeInput

properties.name: label
properties.description: Label text for the input (required for accessibility).

properties.name: description
properties.description: Description text displayed between the label and input.

properties.name: isLabelHidden
properties.description: Visually hides the label while keeping it accessible to screen readers. Default: false.

properties.name: isRequired
properties.description: Marks the field as required and sets aria-required. Mutually exclusive with isOptional. Default: false.

properties.name: isDisabled
properties.description: Disables the input and suppresses interactions. Default: false.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Status indicator that colors the border and displays an icon. When a message is provided it is rendered below the input.

properties.name: width
properties.description: Width of the field (number = pixels, string used as-is, e.g. "100%"). Sizes the whole field (label, control, and status) so they stay aligned.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Controlled time value in ISO format (HH:MM or HH:MM:SS).

properties.name: onChange
properties.description: Callback fired when the time changes. Receives undefined when the input is cleared.

properties.name: min
properties.description: Minimum selectable time in ISO format. Values outside the range are rejected.

properties.name: max
properties.description: Maximum selectable time in ISO format. Values outside the range are rejected.

properties.name: hasSeconds
properties.description: Includes seconds in the time display and parsing. Default: false.

properties.name: hasClear
properties.description: Shows a clear button when a value is set and the input is not disabled. Default: false.

properties.name: hourFormat
properties.description: Controls the display format. '12h' shows AM/PM (e.g. '2:30 PM'); '24h' uses 24-hour notation (e.g. '14:30'). Default: '12h'.

properties.name: increment
properties.description: Number of minutes to add or subtract when the user presses the up or down arrow key. Default: 1.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Placeholder text shown when no time is selected. When the input is focused and empty, a format hint overrides this text. Default: 'Select a time'.

properties.name: size
properties.description: Controls the height of the input element. Default: 'md'.

name: Timestamp

properties.name: value
properties.description: The date/time to display. Accepts Unix timestamps (seconds) or ISO 8601 strings.

properties.name: format
properties.description: Display format. 'relative' uses the locale's native long relative-time wording ('2 hours ago' in English), 'relative_short' uses its narrow pattern ('2h ago' in English) for compact surfaces, 'date' shows 'Mar 21, 2025', 'date_long' shows 'March 21, 2025', 'date_weekday' shows 'Wed, Mar 21, 2025', 'date_time' shows 'Mar 21, 2025, 2:51 PM', 'time' shows '2:51 PM', 'system_*' variants use ISO-style formatting, 'unix_seconds' shows the Unix time in whole seconds since the epoch (an absolute, zone-independent value), 'auto' switches from relative to date_time based on recency. Default: 'date_time'.
